title: International Day of Information for All
summary: UNESCO highlights the International Day of Information for All, which advocates for equal access to information and knowledge for everyone, including persons with disabilities, to ensure no one is left behind.
body:
UNESCO highlights the International Day of Information for All, which advocates for equal access to information and knowledge for everyone, including persons with disabilities, to ensure no one is left behind.
